name_ja: 天領日田ひなまつり健康マラソン
full_name_ja: 第28回天領日田ひなまつり健康マラソン大会
description_ja: 「日本三大美林」とも称される日田杉の中を走るハーフマラソン。日田市陸上競技場を発着し、スタート直後にレトロな町並みの観光名所「豆田町」を通過する。最大高低差は50m。参加賞は日田市出身の諫山創さんにちなんだ『進撃の巨人』コラボTシャツ。
description_en: A half marathon through the Hita cedar forests, counted among Japan's three most beautiful forests. Starting and finishing at Hita City Athletics Stadium, the course passes the retro streets of Mamedamachi shortly after the start. The maximum elevation difference is 50m. The participation gift is an Attack on Titan collaboration T-shirt, honoring Hita-born manga artist Hajime Isayama.
reception_note_ja: ゼッケン・計測チップ等は事前に郵送。前日（3/13 14:00〜17:00）または当日（7:00〜各種目スタート30分前）に日田市陸上競技場で参加賞を受け取る
reception_note_en: Bibs and timing chips are mailed in advance. Collect the participation gift at Hita City Athletics Stadium the day before (Mar 13, 14:00-17:00) or on race day (from 7:00 until 30 min before each start).

course_info.highlights_ja: 日田杉の美林の中を走るコース。ハーフ・10kmはスタート直後に江戸時代の町並みが残る豆田町を通過する
course_info.highlights_en: A course through beautiful Hita cedar forests. The half and 10km courses pass the Edo-period streets of Mamedamachi shortly after the start.
course_info.notes_ja: ハーフは18km地点に関門（11:10）あり。給水所はハーフ・10km共用で4箇所を予定（陸上競技場ロータリー、ウッドコンビナート入口、日向野橋付近、垣内橋付近）。中学生は5kmのみ参加可。コスプレを対象とした表彰あり
course_info.notes_en: The half marathon has a cutoff at 18km (11:10). Four water stations are planned, shared by the half and 10km courses (stadium rotary, Wood Combinat entrance, near Hyugano Bridge, near Kakiuchi Bridge). Junior high students may enter the 5km only. There is also a cosplay award.

nearby_spots.description_ja: 江戸時代の天領の面影を残す町並み。大会時期は天領日田おひなまつり（2月中旬〜3月末）を開催中
nearby_spots.description_en: Historic streets from Hita's days as a shogunate-controlled town. The Tenryo Hita Hina Doll Festival runs from mid-February to the end of March.

nearby_spots.description_ja: 大会会場で天ヶ瀬温泉の足湯を利用できる（予定）
nearby_spots.description_en: An Amagase Onsen footbath is planned at the venue

participation_gifts.description_en: Free onsen bath tickets and admission tickets to the Tenryo Hita Museum and Hita Gion Yamaboko Hall (planned)

participation_gifts.description_en: Free udon served at the venue (planned)

participation_gifts.description_en: A lottery prize of Hita local products and Mamedamachi shopping district vouchers (worth 1,000 yen)
